0d94e5aaf6927feff25e4fbcd75e547db3df22be.notes: One row per licence: 884 rows, 884 distinct licence numbers. The header's own spellings ('date_issed', '0ccupiers' with a zero) are kept as published. landlord_last_name and landlord_first_name are never mapped, nor street_name and property_number. 5 rows give no postcode and are refused. No licence type or status column: the register lists licences in force. No as_of in the file. Review: districts LE1-LE5 and one LE9, occupiers 3-36, storeys 1-4, dates ISO.

a9547c853cb99749f985d07ee188542fd3f5c001.notes: One row per licence: 3,485 rows, 3,485 distinct licence numbers. There is no postcode column; the district is read from the postcode that ends 'Property Address', found in all 3,485. Never mapped: the holder's and manager's names and addresses, the address itself, Easting, Northing, Longitude, Latitude and Location. The register's own Notice says it is for identifying licensed HMOs and not for marketing, and that nobody named in it consented to that; nothing that names anybody is carried. The Notice also says the maximum persons follows an inspection while rooms and amenities are as the applicant stated, so only the former is mapped. Zero persons and storeys of 0 or 200 appear and are nulled with a note. Dates are day-first. Review: 25 districts, NW1 the largest; two types, two statuses.

11ecd966cf9b568415b7620460ea01741a1c3238.notes: One row per licence: 5,545 rows, 5,545 distinct reference numbers. Never mapped: LICENCE_HOLDER_NAME, PROPERTY_ADDRESS, X, Y, EASTING, NORTHING, WARD. 27 rows give no readable postcode and are refused. Three licence types, including 11 '257 HMO' (buildings converted into flats, section 257 of the Housing Act 2004), kept in the publisher's words. Zero occupants or households appear and are nulled with a note. No status column and no as_of in the file. Review: 13 districts, SW4 the largest; dates year-first with a time that is always midnight.

56e1871a28940d20246e5ccd3762504fbd9e10b9.notes: Not a register: Stirling publishes the number of licensed properties at each postcode, one row per postcode (137 postcodes, each once). The row therefore stands for its count, in 'licences'; nothing about any one licence is published, so type, dates and occupancy are absent. Ward and Community_Council are not mapped. Review: 9 districts, FK8 the largest; counts 1 to 39; every row published 30 October 2024.

8a0a3e68c8341c24f2b5dace608edf1a3ec3fcd6.reject: A summary, not a register: the number of HMO licences in Stirling in each year, 23 rows. It has no property and no postcode, so it cannot say where.

7cfc2a5505a3328b24d489ee0a0eabc7dc2b7335.notes: Served as an HTML table under a CSV name; read by the extractor's HTML table path since 27 Sep. One row per licence: 109 rows, 109 distinct references. The district is read from the postcode that ends 'address', found in all 109 (KT4, KT17, KT18, KT19). Never mapped: address, uprn, ogc_fid. 'property_classification' is the address's AddressBase class, not the licence's type, so it is not licence_type. One row has its cells shifted by one; its dates will not read and are left null. Zero occupancy is nulled by the family rule.

53052d4ab88410c821735e3716c3cdceb1b386a9.notes: Admitted on the council's own portal statement of the OGL v3 (decision DM 2026-09-27; data.gov.uk's copy lost the licence). 1,696 rows for 1,611 licences: a licence with two managers is listed once per manager, identical but for the manager's name and address, so one row per reference is kept. Never mapped: HMO ADDRESS, MANAGERS NAME, MANAGERS ADDRESS, LICENCE HOLDER, LICENCE HOLDER ADDRESS. The dataset notes say it is not for marketing and nobody named in it consented to that. 'TOTAL NUMBER PERMITTED' reaches 760 once, above the family's range, and is nulled with a note. Dates are day-month-year with a two-digit year.

ed3667cbd8c3cf67913e6a22116ad835ccd4c100.notes: Accepted by decision DM 2026-09-27 (OGL v3.0 for the information; the One Scotland Mapping Agreement covers mapping data this family does not carry). Not a register but a log of applications since 2020: 6,523 rows, of which 5,807 granted, for 4,974 distinct licences. Kept: the latest grant of each licence number whose expiry date has not passed on the build day, about 2,490 on 27 Sep 2026. Not counted: 611 licences with an application awaiting reports, some of them renewals, and every refusal and withdrawal. 'LIVING_ACCOMMODATION' is the address; the district is read from the postcode at its end (97.5% have one). 'CATEGORY' (A: up to 10 persons, B: 11 or more) is the only kind the register gives. Never mapped: LICENCE_HOLDER, LETTING_AGENT, the address itself, WARD, SHAPEAREA, SHAPELEN.

8a6774f999dabd8730c119c740a9d2f13d894b3e.notes: Found by search, not in any catalogue: the XLSX linked from the council's HMO page, 'HMO register 4 August 2026'. Licence read from the site's copyright page, which grants reuse of information on the website under the OGL (it speaks of Crown copyright material; noted, accepted). 139 licences with 139 distinct references, all with a postcode (NG15, NG16, NG17). The sheet's other 88 rows are blank or section notes and give no licence. Never mapped: the street address, Town, UPRN, 'Flare Ref'. One expiry date reads 1930, a keying error in the source, kept as published.

5a2b10f4e29c2ac2c7e38ae13471f916009b858a.notes: Found by search: the council's portal serves the current CSV; data.gov.uk's record of the same register states the UK OGL and its old file link is dead. 1,405 rows, one per licensed property; there is no licence number column, and five addresses appear twice (separately licensed parts, kept). The district is read from the postcode ending 'Premises Address', found in 1,403 (TW, W and UB districts). Never mapped: the address, ward. Dates are day-first; no start date or as_of is published.
